The normal uterus confirms intact Müllerian development (no AMH excess), consistent with 46,XX genotype and absence of testicular tissue. While 17α-hydroxylase deficiency classically causes *hypertension and hypokalemia*, these may be subtle or missed in adolescents; their absence does *not* exclude it — and the summary states no BP or electrolyte data are provided.
